description: This file defines the StopWatch class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides timing functionalities such as measuring elapsed time and resetting the stopwatch, utilizing the SystemInfo class to access system ticks.

classes.name: StopWatch
classes.description: A class that provides timing functionalities such as measuring elapsed time and resetting the stopwatch, using system ticks.

methods.name: Elapsed
methods.description: Returns the number of ticks elapsed since the last measurement or reset.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch to the current system tick count and returns the elapsed ticks since the last reset.
